svg.text: ESP32 Attendance Node — Audio & UI Wiring
Matches cd.kicad_sch · KiCad 10.0.7 · every net cross-checked against cd.net
• Wire crossings without a dot are NOT connected.
• IO25 = DAC1, IO26 = DAC2 (8-bit DAC outputs).
• LED has no series resistor — internal resistor assumed.
• Amp right channel R+ / R− is unused (no-connect).
common ground return — every ground pin returns to this single bus
